Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Meera - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches
4. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay dances to the music.]

Tanay: "What happened?"

[Tanay sings a song.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Meera: "That's great!"

[Tanay shakes his head.]

Tanay (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Tanay thinks for a moment.]

Tanay (surprised): "And then?"

[Tanay shouts angrily.]

Tanay (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay gives Mother a flower.]

Shalini: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Meera and Shalini stand near him.]

Tanay: "Mom, look over here."

[Tanay combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

[Meera applies kajal to her eyes.]

Tanay: "And then?"

[Tanay gulps down a glass of milk.]

Meera: "What happened?"

[Tanay serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Meera: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay studies for his exam.]

Tanay (laughing): "Let's see."

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay plays cricket in the park.]

Shalini (surprised): "Tanay, are you okay?"

[Tanay swings on the swing.]

Shalini: "Good job, Tanay!"

[Tanay plays with his dog.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Tanay stands in the bedroom. Shalini and Meera stand near him.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Tanay goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Tanay: "Careful!"

[Tanay sits on the edge of the bed.]

Shalini: "I really enjoyed today."
